I don't usually leave reviews, but I really wanted to share my experience. Yesterday I was completely panicked because my cat, Mimime, who is almost 17 years old, started spotting blood from her urinary tract. She was going back and forth to the litter box and seemed to be in pain. I thought it might be cystitis, but given her advanced age, the presence of blood scared me. Plus, she seemed to be suffering, and I couldn't catch it. I really thought it was the end; I was terrified. Of course, my vet was out that day, and I had no other option but to search online for a nearby vet, since I live on foot. I found this clinic, and they didn't hesitate to tell me to come in even though I hadn't made an appointment. That reassured me a lot, and the treatment was very quick. My Mimine received an injection, and today she is doing better and slowly recovering. Thank you again so much...

Thank you, Mr. Delsaux!

I completely disagree with the positive reviews about this veterinarian. I had to have my old, sick, and weak dog euthanized to end his suffering.

I had visited this doctor a few days prior, and he gave him an antibiotic injection that he didn't tolerate well, as it made him even weaker. Since he was in so much pain and could no longer stand, we decided to put him down, but the veterinarian didn't give him the initial sedative injection, the one given before the lethal injection, which is painful for the animal because it begins by paralyzing their muscles and breathing.

My dog ​​was too weak to express anything... The veterinarian took advantage of my pain and distress to save money on my pet's death, which is despicable. He may seem nice on the surface, but his actions are horrific and haunt me. I hope my dog ​​passed away peacefully. I strongly advise you to avoid this veterinarian. I have many testimonies from neighbors who have also told me disastrous stories about him.
Thank you for your positive review!

Dr. Defasque is a very attentive and gentle veterinarian towards animals and understanding towards their owners. Aline, always very intuitive and full of advice for animals, gave me a lot of advice for my Tigrou's health for 3 months. Unfortunately, my baby passed away on March 25th. It is heartbreaking for me, but my presence until his last breath showed him all my love: 13 years of loyalty to this veterinary practice, truly filled with humanity. I highly recommend it.
